title: Synthetic Data Generation for AWS S3 Traffic Using Generative Models
summary: An AWS capstone project that generates synthetic S3 storage-traffic data to evaluate future hard-drive performance, comparing generative approaches such as CTGAN, TimeGAN, and DoppelGANger. The notebooks instantiate and fit SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and CTGANSynthesizer on the tabular traffic data and evaluate them with sdmetrics' QualityReport and run_diagnostic, finding Gaussian Copula the faster, higher-quality performer.
